verses: Aasmano aur zamin mein jo hai (sab) Allah ki tasbeeh ker rahey hain, woh zabardast ba-hikmat hai
Aasmano aur zamin ki badshahat ussi ki hai, o hi zindagi deta hai aur maut bhi aur woh her cheez per qadir hai
O hi pehlay hai aur o hi peechay, o hi zahir hai aur o hi makhfi, aur woh her cheez ko bakhoobi jannay wala hai

O hi hai jiss ney aasmano aur zamin ko chhe din mein peda kiya phir arsh per mustawi ho gaya. Woh (khoob) janta hai uss cheez ko jo zamin mein jaye aur jo uss say niklay aur jo aasman say neechay aaye aur jo kuch charh ker uss mein jaye, aur jahan kahen tum ho woh tumharay sath hai aur jo tum ker rahey ho Allah dekh raha hai
Aasmano ki aur zamin ki badshahi ussi ki hai. Aur tamam kaam ussi ki taraf lotaye jatay hain
O hi raat ko din mein ley jata hai aur o hi din ko raat mein dakhil ker deta hai aur seenon kay bhedon ka woh poora aalam hai

Allah per aur uss kay rasool per eman ley aao aur uss maal mein say kharach kero jiss mein Allah ney tumhen (doosron ka) janasheen banaya hai pus tum mein say jo eman layen aur kheyraat keren unhen boht bara sawab milay ga
Tum Allah per eman kiyon nahi latay? Halankay khud rasool tumhen apney rab per eman lanay dawat dey raha hai aur agar tum momin ho to woh to tum say mazboot ehad o-paymaan bhi ley chuka hai
Woh (Allah) hi hai jo apney banday per wazeh aayaten utarta hai takay woh tumhen andheron say noor ki taraf ley jaye yaqeenan Allah Taalaa tum per narmi kerney wala reham kerney wala hai

Tumhen kiya ho gaya hai jo tum Allah ki raah mein kharach nahi kertay? Dar-asal aasmano aur zaminon ki meeras ka malik (tanha) Allah hi hai tum mein say jin logon ney fatah say pehlay fi sabeelillah Allah diya hai aur qitaal kiya hai woh (doosron kay) barabar nahi, balkay)yeh unn say boht baray darjay kay hain jinhon ney fatah kay baad kheyraaten den aur jihad kiye. Haan bhalaee ka wada to Allah Taalaa ka unn sab say hai jo kuch tum ker rahey ho uss say Allah khabardaar hai
Kaun hai jo Allah Taalaa ko achi tarah qarz dey phir Allah Taalaa ussay uss kay liye barhata chala jaye aur uss kay liye pasandeedah ajar sabit ho jaye

Qayamat kay din to dekhay ga kay momin mardon aur aurton ka noor unn kay aagay aagay aur unn kay dayen dor raha hoga aaj tumhen unn jannaton ki khush khabri hai jin kay neechay nehren jari hain jin mein hamesha ki rehaeesh hai. Yeh hai bari kaamyabi

Uss din munafiq mard o aurat eman walon say kahen gay kay humara intizar to kero kay hum bhi tumharay noor say kuch roshni hasil ker len. Jawab diya jaye ga kay tum apney peechay lot jao aur roshni talash kero. Phir unn kay aur unn kay darmiyan aik deewar haeel ker di jaye gi jiss mein darwaza bhi hoga. Uss kay androoni hissa mein to rehmat hogi aur bahir ki taraf azab hoga

Yeh chala chala ker unn say kahen gay kay kiya hum tumharay sath na thay woh kahen gay kay haan thay to sahi lekin tum ney apney aap ko fitna mein phansa rakha tha aur intizar mein hi rahey aur shak o shuba)yeh kertay rahey aur tumhen tumhari fazool tamannao ney dhokay mein hi rakha yahan tak kay Allah ka hukum aa phoncha aur tumhen Allah kay baray mein dhokay denay walay ney dhokay mein hi rakha
Al-gharz, aaj tum say na fidya (aur na badla) qabool kiya jaye ga aur na kafiron say tum (sab) ka thikana dozakh hai. O hi tumhari rafiq hai aur woh bura thikana hai

Kiya abb tak eman walon kay liye waqt nahi aaya kay unn kay dil zikar elahi say aur jo haq utar chuka hai uss say naram ho jayen aur unn ki tarah na ho jayen jinhen unn say pehlay kitab di gaee thi phir jab unn per aik zamaney daraz guzar gaya to unn kay dil sakht ho gaye aur unn mein boht say fasiq hain
Yaqeen mano kay Allah hi zamin ko uss ki maut kay baad zindah ker deta hai. Hum ney to tumharay liye apni aayaten biyan ker den takay tum samjho
Be-shak sadqa denay walay mard aur sadqa denay wali aurten aur jo Allah ko khuloos kay sath qarz dey rahey hain. Unn kay liye yeh barhaya jaye ga aur unn kay liye pasandeedah ajar o sawab hai

Allah aur uss kay rasool per jo eman rakhtay hain o hi log apney rab kay nazdeek siddique aur shaheed hain unn kay liye unn ka ajar aur unn ka noor hai, aur jo log kufur kertay hain aur humari aayaton jhutlatay hain woh jahannumi hain

Khoob jaan rakho kay duniya ki zindagi sirf khel tamasha zeenat aur aapas mein fakhar (o ghuroor) aur maal o aulad mein aik ka doosray say apney aap ko ziyadah batlana hai, jaisay barish aur uss ki paidawaar kisano ko achi maloom hoti hai phir jab woh khushk ho jati hai to zard rang mein uss ko tum dekhtay ho phir woh bilkul choora choora ho jati hai aur aakhirat mein sakht azab aur Allah ki maghfirat aur razamandi hai aur duniya ki zindagi ba-juz dhokay kay saman kay aur kuch bhi to nahi

(aao) doro apney rab ki maghfirat ki taraf aur uss jannat ki taraf jiss ki wusat aasman o zamin ki wusat kay barabar hai yeh unn kay liye banaee hai jo Allah per aur uss kay rasoolon per eman rakhtay hain. Yeh Allah ka fazal hai jissay chahaye dey aur Allah baray fazal wala hai

Na koi museebat duniya mein aati hai na (khaas) tumhari janon mein, magar uss say pehlay kay hum uss ko peda keren woh aik khaas kitab mein likhi hui hai, yeh (kaam) Allah Taalaa per (bilkul) aasan hai
Takay tum apney say fot shuda kissi cheez per ranjeedah na ho jaya kero aur na ata kerdah cheez per itra jao, aur itraney walay shekhi khoron ko Allah pasand nahi farmata
Jo (khud bhi) bukhul keren aur doosron ko (bhi) bukhul ki taleem den. Suno! jo bhi mun pheray Allah bey-niaz aur sazawaar hamd o sana hai

Yaqeenan hum ney apney payghumbaron ko khulli daleelen dey ker bheja aur unn kay sath kitab aur meean (tarazoo) nazil farmaya takay log adal per qaeem rahen. Aur hum ney lohay ko utara jiss mein sakht haibat o qooat hai aur logon kay liye aur bhi (boht say) faeeday hain aur uss liye bhi kay Allah jaan ley kay uss ki aur uss kay rasoolon ki madad dekhay kaun kerta hai, be-shak Allah qooat wala aur zabardast hai

Be-shak hum ney Nooh aur Ibrahim (alaihi as-salam) ko (payghumbar bana ker) bheja aur hum ney unn dono ki aulad mein payghumbari aur kitab jari rakhi to unn mein say kuch to raah yafta huye aur unn mein say aksar boht nafarman rahey

Unn kay baad phir bhi hum apney rasoolon ko pay dar pay bhejtay rahey aur unn kay baad Isa bann Maryam (alaihi as-salam) ko bheja aur unhen Injeel ata farmaee aur unn kay mannay walon kay dilon mein shafqat aur reham peda kerdiya haan rehbaniyat (tarak duniya) to unn logon ney az khud ijad kerli thi hum ney unn per ussay wajib na kiya tha siwaye Allah ki raza kay. So unhon ney uss ki poori riyayat na ki, phir bhi hum ney unn mein say jo eman laye thay. Unhen unn ka ajar diya aur unn mein ziyadah tar log nafarman hain

Aey woh logo jo eman laye ho! Allah say dartay raha kero aur uss kay rasool per eman lao Allah tumhen apni rehmat ka dohra hissa dey ga aur tumhen noor dey ga jiss ki roshni mein tum chalo phiro gay aur tumharay gunah bhi moaf farma ga, Allah bakhshney wala meharban hai

Yeh uss liye kay ahl kitab jaan len kay Allah kay fazal kay kissi hissa per bhi unhen ikhtiyar nahi aur yeh kay (sara) fazal Allah hi kay hath hai woh jissay chahaye dey, aur Allah hai hi baray fazal wala
